name: The Knights
caption: World Tag Team Champions who retained by disqualification over the Doggpound at the federation's 4 March 1997 card.

name: The Doggpound
caption: Challenged unsuccessfully for the World Tag Team Championship at the federation's 4 March 1997 card.

name: The Powers of Destruction
caption: The federation founder's own tag team with Pain, challenging unsuccessfully for the World Tag Team Championship at the federation's 12 March 1997 card.

tenures.source: The federation's own 25 February and 12 March 1997 cards.

name: Eclipse & Cataclysm
caption: World Tag Team Champions by the federation's 12 March 1997 card, retaining on a restart with their allies' interference.

name: The Warlords
caption: A tag pairing that fell in a three-way tag elimination tournament match at the federation's 12 March 1997 card, the same night Chaos lost the Extreme Internet Championship.
